title: 4 Stages of the Customer Journey for Your Small Business

facts.fact: The page describes the customer journey as the path customers take from awareness to engagement, then transaction, and finally retention.
facts.quote: The customer journey spans a variety of touchpoints by which the customer moves from awareness to engagement and eventually to transaction and retention.

facts.fact: The article was published on August 10, 2017.
In the awareness stage, a potential customer becomes aware of a company or brand through advertising, cold calls, email blasts, or other marketing vehicles.
facts.quote: The person becomes aware of a company or brand via advertising, cold calls, email blasts or other marketing vehicles.

facts.fact: The page gives IT firms signing up for monthly services as an example of the transaction stage.
facts.quote: IT firms, for example, may find new customers signing up for monthly services
